claim_boundary: Agent.6 operating design, not evidence of recruited developers, events, partnerships, international attraction, conversion, or retention.

stages.resource_input: capability statement, conduct agreement, attribution and conflict disclosure
stages.stop_condition: identity/authority cannot be verified, conflict concealed, or conduct rule rejected

stages.resource_input: public-interest problem, beneficiary, non-user path, data and site boundary
stages.stop_condition: no accountable problem owner, public value, permission, or non-digital fallback

stages.owner_type: test operator and independent reviewer types
stages.resource_input: sandbox, synthetic/authorised data, equipment, stop and appeal drill
stages.output_evidence: test version, baseline, incident/rollback and evaluation receipts
stages.review_cadence: each run and weekly during G3
stages.stop_condition: red-line KPI, boundary, safety, privacy, access, or stop-control failure

stages.resource_input: source, licence, model/tool, human review, limits and withdrawal route
stages.output_evidence: public provenance card and accessible release package
stages.review_cadence: before release and on every correction
stages.stop_condition: source, rights, accessibility, attribution, or factual review fails

stages.resource_input: published package, version, limitations, local site/legal review and restoration plan
stages.output_evidence: traceable fork, difference log, local owner and exit receipt
stages.review_cadence: before local activation and at G4
stages.stop_condition: local conditions invalidate transfer, owner absent, or failure history is removed

annual_cycle.evidence_to_advance: role cards and rights-cleared contribution records
consented baseline, test and correction receipts
failure, repair, withdrawal, reuse and closure records
